drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input_schema and the reuse, shape, publish, reachability steps with their submit shapes); read from the row's words, no test runs it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:put-it-in-the-world to turn our bakery training sheet into a public how-to page at https://example.com/train, with no paid ads and only publishing I have approved."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Write the request, its scope, the constraints and the actions you authorize (publishing a page, for example); add source_id when it came from a shared source.
2. Say "Run workflow:put-it-in-the-world". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps reuse, shape, publish, reachability.
3. At each step the answer holds a summary, the evidence (id, source, what was observed) and a state for each requirement; a blocked requirement stays open with its wall, never marked complete.
4. At reachability, read that the real published address was opened and the served content checked, and that a real-user test was done or marked not applicable.
